subtitles.title: Software Supply-Chain Vulnerabilities & Hidden Reachability
subtitles.text: Hello everyone, and respected judges!

subtitles.title: Software Supply-Chain Vulnerabilities & Hidden Reachability
subtitles.text: Today, modern software applications are built using hundreds of open-source packages across npm, Python, Go, and GitHub workflows.

subtitles.title: Software Supply-Chain Vulnerabilities & Hidden Reachability
subtitles.text: While open-source libraries allow engineering teams to build products rapidly, managing their security has become extremely challenging.

subtitles.title: Software Supply-Chain Vulnerabilities & Hidden Reachability
subtitles.text: In large codebases, applications contain deeply nested dependency trees with multiple transitive layers.

subtitles.title: Software Supply-Chain Vulnerabilities & Hidden Reachability
subtitles.text: The critical problem for engineering teams is knowing: Which vulnerabilities are actually reachable and active in our production code, and which ones are never called?

subtitles.title: Software Supply-Chain Vulnerabilities & Hidden Reachability
subtitles.text: Without reachability analysis, developers spend weeks chasing false alarms or risk breaking live backend APIs during package upgrades.

subtitles.title: Software Supply-Chain Vulnerabilities & Hidden Reachability
subtitles.text: That is why modern software security requires a deeper, code-aware approach.

subtitles.title: SupplyGraph: Application Security Posture Management (ASPM)
subtitles.text: To address this challenge, we created SupplyGraph.

subtitles.title: SupplyGraph: Application Security Posture Management (ASPM)
subtitles.text: SupplyGraph is an Application Security Posture Management platform designed to give developers complete visibility into their software supply chain.

subtitles.title: SupplyGraph: Application Security Posture Management (ASPM)
subtitles.text: Instead of treating dependencies as flat isolated lists, SupplyGraph inspects your actual code and builds an interactive visual attack graph.

subtitles.title: SupplyGraph: Application Security Posture Management (ASPM)
subtitles.text: It connects your application from user-facing entry points all the way down to deeply nested packages.

subtitles.title: SupplyGraph: Application Security Posture Management (ASPM)
subtitles.text: SupplyGraph clearly verifies whether an execution path can actually reach a vulnerable component in runtime.

subtitles.title: SupplyGraph: Application Security Posture Management (ASPM)
subtitles.text: When a reachable security risk is identified, SupplyGraph provides safe, line-by-line code patches that preserve application functionality, while testing untrusted packages inside an isolated detonation sandbox.

sections.title: Graph Traversal, Blast Radius & Five Preloaded Real-World Scenarios

subtitles.title: Graph Traversal, Blast Radius & Five Preloaded Real-World Scenarios
subtitles.text: Let us examine the core capabilities of SupplyGraph and our five preloaded real-world scenarios:

subtitles.title: Graph Traversal, Blast Radius & Five Preloaded Real-World Scenarios
subtitles.text: First is the Attack Graph, powered by graph traversal algorithms to visually map call paths from your code to external libraries, highlighting the exact reachability path in red.

subtitles.title: Graph Traversal, Blast Radius & Five Preloaded Real-World Scenarios
subtitles.text: Second is the Blast Radius Score from zero to hundred, quantifying the operational risk of each finding.

subtitles.title: Graph Traversal, Blast Radius & Five Preloaded Real-World Scenarios
subtitles.text: Third is the Autonomous Executive AI, translating technical vulnerability data into clear executive summaries and prioritized remediation steps.

subtitles.title: Graph Traversal, Blast Radius & Five Preloaded Real-World Scenarios
subtitles.text: And fourth is the CycloneDX SBOM, generating industry-standard Software Bill of Materials documents with deterministic SHA-256 verification.

subtitles.title: Graph Traversal, Blast Radius & Five Preloaded Real-World Scenarios
subtitles.text: To demonstrate this, SupplyGraph includes five preloaded scenarios:

subtitles.title: Graph Traversal, Blast Radius & Five Preloaded Real-World Scenarios
subtitles.text: Scenario A traces a transitive Log4j call path traveling deep into server logging.

subtitles.title: Graph Traversal, Blast Radius & Five Preloaded Real-World Scenarios
subtitles.text: Scenario B audits JavaScript Prototype Pollution, identifying risky object merging.

subtitles.title: Graph Traversal, Blast Radius & Five Preloaded Real-World Scenarios
subtitles.text: Scenario C detects insecure Python pickle deserialization before execution.

subtitles.title: Graph Traversal, Blast Radius & Five Preloaded Real-World Scenarios
subtitles.text: Scenario D audits GitHub Actions workflows to ensure immutable commit hashes.

subtitles.title: Graph Traversal, Blast Radius & Five Preloaded Real-World Scenarios
subtitles.text: And Scenario E analyzes malicious package lifecycle scripts and installation hooks.

sections.title: Deep Dive (knadh/listmonk), Fix with AI, Code Reviewer & Conclusion

subtitles.title: Deep Dive (knadh/listmonk), Fix with AI, Code Reviewer & Conclusion
subtitles.text: Now let us examine a real-world open-source repository: listmonk by Kailash Nadh.

subtitles.title: Deep Dive (knadh/listmonk), Fix with AI, Code Reviewer & Conclusion
subtitles.text: When scanning a multi-module repository like this, SupplyGraph indexes all thirty-five submodules and manifests, providing a unified inventory across frontend, backend, and workflow automation.

subtitles.title: Deep Dive (knadh/listmonk), Fix with AI, Code Reviewer & Conclusion
subtitles.text: It identifies twenty-one findings across direct and transitive dependencies, computing a contextual Blast Radius score of sixty out of hundred.

subtitles.title: Deep Dive (knadh/listmonk), Fix with AI, Code Reviewer & Conclusion
subtitles.text: With our Fix with AI feature, SupplyGraph generates evidence-based, non-breaking remediation prompts specifically structured for AI coding assistants like Antigravity, Cursor, and Copilot.

subtitles.title: Deep Dive (knadh/listmonk), Fix with AI, Code Reviewer & Conclusion
subtitles.text: In the AI Code Reviewer, developers can inspect surgical unified git diffs that correct the specific vulnerable lines rather than forcing broad version jumps.

subtitles.title: Deep Dive (knadh/listmonk), Fix with AI, Code Reviewer & Conclusion
subtitles.text: And in our Detonation Sandbox, lifecycle scripts run inside an isolated container where malicious network requests and file modifications are safely contained.

subtitles.title: Deep Dive (knadh/listmonk), Fix with AI, Code Reviewer & Conclusion
subtitles.text: SupplyGraph protects your modern software supply chain before production deployment.

subtitles.title: Deep Dive (knadh/listmonk), Fix with AI, Code Reviewer & Conclusion
subtitles.text: Thank you so much!
